title: AppFlow key defaults cannot carry constant action params
body: sn-editorinput1: [FlowKeyDefault] binds a chord to an action with no params, so keys 1-4 -> SetViewAngle(index) needed four param-less alias actions (SelectViewAngle0..3). Wanted: a key default carrying declared constant params (or an element-trigger-like {param} form) so one SetViewAngle binds four keys; then delete the aliases.

title: AppFlow InputProfile binds chords only: no axis or drag bindings
body: sn-editorinput1: right-drag orbit, wheel zoom, held-key pan/zoom/look and a value-label drag-scrub are translated by the host (CameraDispatchesFromInput, StepParameterScrub) into OrbitCamera/PanCamera/ZoomCamera/SetParameter dispatches. Needed shape: an axis/drag trigger declaration (source: pointer delta | wheel | key axis | held pointer on element pattern; target action + param mapping + scale) in AppFlowReference.cs, resolved by InputProfile/BindingStore, so the host only feeds raw state. Then delete the host translation.

title: UI has no keyboard/text/pointer event forwarding into the Rml context: typed parameter entry blocked
body: sn-editorinput1 STOP (E4 text input): nothing calls Rml::Context::ProcessKeyDown/ProcessTextInput/ProcessMouseButton*; clicks are hit-tested by UISelectionProviderNode only and InputNode has no character callback. A real <input> bound to SetParameter needs: GLFW char+key forwarding into UIRenderNode's context, focus handling, a generic data-attr value -> action param binding in the View binding. Shipped instead: SetParameter channel action + ScrubParameter drag + reset button.

title: Scene readback hashes drift with auto-exposure; identical states hash differently
body: sn-editorinput1 measured: two fullFrame raw readbacks of one unchanged editor state seconds apart hash differently (background gradient/shading follow the exposure meter); the first two shots 1s apart matched only after settling. Channel witnesses that need 'same state' must compare silhouette+normalised luminance (tools/editor_input_witness.py compare()). Wanted: a readback option that fixes exposure (or a tonemap-free scene-linear readback) so hashes are stable evidence.

title: Brief names a UNDERTOW_ROOT worktree that does not exist; vixen_editor ctests are Disabled and camera tests unbuilt in vixen-wsl-debug
body: sn-editorinput1: the brief's pair-kernel-c2e1188c5e worktree was missing (used batchroot-d7o, which has transpiled/textshader); configure should fail early with a located message naming a valid root. In the vixen-wsl-debug tree vixen_editor_appflow_channel_gate and vixen_editor_capture_producer report 'Not Run (Disabled)' and test_camera_history/test_pick_ray have no target, so the editor ctest set silently shrinks (R796 clarity): say why and how to enable.

title: Action handlers cannot reject: SetViewAngle(9) and SetParameter(out-of-range index) dispatch as Ok
body: sn-editorinput1: AppFlowRuntime handlers return void, so an invalid index is warned in the log while the channel reports dispatchResult Ok (measured: SetViewAngle index 9 -> Ok). A handler-level typed rejection (RejectedByState/InvalidParam) would let agents see the failure.
